26" 7-Speed Electric Beach Cruiser Bike for Men – Powerful & Stylish Ride
Omega is an electric cruiser bike with a fantastic and attractive design, coming with two 26” white wall tires, SHIMANO Tourney 7 speed rear derailleur, dual disk brakes, Panasonic built-in battery, LCD display, XIONGDA powerful motor with 48V,500W, freestyle crankset, and so on. It is perfect for adventure lovers looking for a comfortable riding experience.
Powerful & Efficient 500W Brushless Motor
Equipped with a lightweight 48V 500W high-speed brushless motor, the Tracer OMEGA delivers reliable, quiet power for all your rides—whether you're commuting through the city, cruising along the beach, or enjoying a relaxed weekend trip. With speeds up to 22 mph, it's built for both performance and comfort on every terrain.
02
Long-Range Removable Battery
Powered by a 48V 14Ah removable lithium-ion battery, the Tracer OMEGA gives you the freedom to ride farther—up to 50 miles with pedal assist. Whether you're commuting to work, cruising the boardwalk, or exploring on the weekend, this high-capacity battery delivers consistent power and quick charging in just 4–6 hours. Easily remove it for indoor charging and added convenience.
Shimano 7-Speed Gear System
features a reliable Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, giving you the flexibility to conquer hills, coast smoothly, and adjust effortlessly to changing terrain. Whether you're navigating city streets or cruising beach paths, the smooth and precise shifting ensures a comfortable ride every time.
Mechanical Disc Brakes
Equipped with 180mm front and rear mechanical disc brakes, providing strong, responsive stopping power in all weather conditions. Whether you're cruising downhill or riding through busy city streets, these brakes ensure safe and confident control at every turn.
Comfortable Spring Saddle
The Tracer OMEGA features an ergonomic spring-loaded saddle designed to deliver maximum comfort on every ride. The built-in dual suspension springs absorb bumps and vibrations from uneven roads, reducing pressure on your lower back and making long-distance cruising smoother and more enjoyable.
Smart LCD Display
A clear and easy-to-read LCD display that keeps you informed with real-time riding stats. Monitor your speed, battery level, pedal assist level, and trip distance at a glance. Whether you're commuting or cruising, this intuitive display helps you stay in control and make the most of every ride.
Classic 26"x2.125" White Wall Tires
Rolls on 26"x2.125" white wall tires that combine vintage cruiser style with dependable performance. These wide tires offer excellent grip and shock absorption, providing a smooth and stable ride on pavement, boardwalks, or light trails—perfect for turning heads while you cruise in comfort.
Front and Rear Lights
The Tracer OMEGA comes equipped with built-in front and rear lights to keep you visible and safe during night rides or low-light conditions. The bright headlight illuminates your path ahead, while the rear light ensures you're seen from behind—giving you peace of mind whether you're commuting home or cruising after sunset.
